items.claim: He shoots his takedowns low below the hips, making it easier to run through and finish them.
items.quote: When he shoots, he shoots nice and low. He's not shooting like half upper body. He's not even shooting at the hips. He's shooting below the hips, so it's a lot easier for him to run right through and finish those takedowns.

items.claim: He is a busy fighter who hunts for finishes.
items.quote: He is a busy guy. He does hunt for finishes

items.claim: He fights like a Muay Thai kickboxer with a high guard, moves forward, and throws with insane volume.
items.quote: He is a Muay Thai kickboxer. He fights like a Muay Thai kickboxer. He's kind of got that high guard. He moves forward and he throws with insane volume.

items.claim: He threw around 400 strikes in a three-round Contender Series fight.
items.quote: he threw like 400 strikes in a three-round Contender Series fight.

items.claim: He has a good amount of finishes on his record but is not known as a big power finisher.
items.quote: He does have a good amount of finishes on his record, but he's not known as this big power finisher.
